artifact.frame_name: Nexus Admin Command Center — High Fidelity 1440 v2

page_purpose: Give Ray a calm, scannable view of current Nexus activity, recent change, progress toward revenue, blocked work, decisions, and the next machine action.
layout_hierarchy: 232px navigation rail; 1208px light content surface; branded hero; four executive summaries; two-column detail groups; full-width next-actions footer.
icon_specs: Use semantic navigation/status icons with text labels; status meaning must not rely on color alone.

responsive_rules.1440: Persistent navigation and two-column command surface.
responsive_rules.1024: Collapse or narrow navigation; stack detail groups while preserving readable widths.
responsive_rules.390: Single-column flow; collapsed navigation; cards stack; page scrolls vertically; no horizontal overflow.

scroll_behavior: The page is vertically scrollable; no content is clipped or hidden behind fixed panels.

interaction_rules.summary_cards: Link only when a canonical detail route exists.

live_data_bindings: Use the authenticated admin-live-state projection; do not import or restore src/data/adminCompanyState.json.
accessibility_constraints: touch targets remain usable on mobile

visual_reconstruction_spec.grid: 8 metric cards; hero plus priority panel; three lower columns; three bottom panels

comparison.pass_1: rejected: incomplete and font validation interrupted
comparison.pass_2: semantic high-fidelity composition exported and read back
comparison.major_defects_remaining: mountain artwork is represented by approved visual language but not embedded as a dedicated mountain asset

do_not_change_rules: Do not invent a replacement layout or visual hierarchy.
Do not change Nexus/GoClear branding or approved assets.
Do not replace the React/Vite/Admin route or authentication contract.
Do not expose secrets, tokens, tenant identifiers, or raw PII.
Only bounded accessibility, responsive, and functional corrections are allowed after approval.
